content.thinking: The flag keeps flipping, and the errors seem to follow its state: they stopped soon after Argus switched it off, and they resume when it turns back on. That points to the flag as the cause, with the "still firing" alert just lagging because of its evaluation window. So I'll answer feature-flag-toggle, from off to on.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on at 2026-11-04T09:02:00Z. That enabled a spend_summary code path that raises ZeroDivisionError on account page requests. The error rate rose from about 1% to 30-40%. Errors follow the flag state minute by minute: they stop when it evaluates off (09:08, 09:10, 09:13) and return when it evaluates on (09:09, 09:12, 09:18). The earlier 'off' action did not clear the alert because the flag was re-enabled afterwards and the 10-minute average stayed high.

supporting_evidence.claim: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on (actor admin)
monthly-spend-feature=off 12 / on 188 - 200 evaluations; ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47; account page error rate at 29.50%
monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations; account page error rate at 0.50% (errors vanish when the flag is off)
monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations; ZeroDivisionError ... error rate 34.00% (errors return when the flag is on)
No deploys in the window; p50, p95 and p99 latency, memory and CPU stayed flat while the error rate stepped from 0.01 to 0.295
